verdict.rationale: The docs describe the whole loop. ByteAsk builds and runs programs under AddressSanitizer to surface issues, which covers reproduction. It joins a live gdb session through a bridge and reports frames, files and line numbers, which covers narrowing down root causes. It then compiles, runs the test suite and hands back a diff that 'survived the debugger', which covers verifying fixes. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration (all evidence is vendor-authored), and in-depth documentation of the reproduction step itself (e.g., building a minimal repro from a bug report).
